name: Dracula
source:
Once a human aristocrat, Dracula still carries himself with the elegance and poise from a long time past -- a sharp contrast to his son's rebellious demeanor and clothing.

Known for ruling over vampires with an iron fist, Dracula is as feared as he's respected.

[From [url=http://monstrousloversevn.tumblr.com/characters]official site[/url]]
